pageCache.text:
Kensington Prep School is an award-winning, independent school for girls aged 4-11, based in Fulham. We focus on growing great minds – by encouraging girls from day one to investigate the world with confidence, supported by an incredibly rich and inspiring curriculum. As a result, girls achieve outstanding results, yet always in a truly supportive and nurturing environment.
Growing Great Minds
We are dedicated to nurturing curious, creative, happy, and healthy individuals through a holistic approach to education.
The curriculum at Ken Prep is meticulously crafted to embody the ‘Growing Great Minds’ vision and to achieve academic excellence while providing outstanding pastoral care.
We have a proud tradition combined with innovative teaching. Our girls achieve outstanding results and go on to some of the best day and boarding schools in London and the country.
Why Kensington Prep?
Exam results are almost a by-product at Kensington Prep School. It’s a result of everything else the school does. The result is happy, confident girls which is how it should be.
Register your daughter
Entry to Kensington Prep School at all levels is selective. Most girls join in Reception at 4+ and a small number of occasional places arise higher up the school and at 7+. The first step to apply to the school is to register your daughter.

Our manifesto and school values underpin everything we do and are an important aspect of school life.

Our ethos
Kindness and respect for each other.
We pull out the stops to nurture friendships and a sense of community. We want everyone to feel we are all working together as a team with the best interests of the pupils at the heart of what we do. To support this, we have an Open Door Policy so parents have the comfort of having a listening ear.
Our school community is based on an ethos of mutual respect and consideration. We are committed to providing a safe and happy learning environment for all. We do not tolerate racial discrimination, harassment or victimisation of any kind.
All GDST schools strive to be inclusive environments in which the wellbeing of every young person comes first, and where every girl – no matter her background – can learn without limits.

pageCache.pageTitle: Growing Great Minds | Kensington Prep School
pageCache.text:
We are dedicated to nurturing curious, creative, happy, and healthy individuals through a holistic approach to education.
The curriculum at Ken Prep is meticulously crafted to embody the ‘Growing Great Minds’ vision. Our curriculum is designed to achieve academic excellence while providing outstanding pastoral care to all our pupils. It is tailored to meet the specific needs of our girls, offering numerous opportunities for exploratory teaching and learning methods, as well as varied enrichment opportunities.
Rooted in the core values of kindness, honesty, integrity, and respect, our curriculum aims at fostering effective learning characteristics in our pupils. It is broad and balanced, yet delves deep to develop critical thinkers and problem solvers. Our overarching goal is to cultivate well-rounded individuals equipped with the skills and knowledge to thrive in an ever-evolving world.
Happy minds
At Kensington Prep, we are committed to developing happy minds through a curriculum that nurtures not only academic excellence but also key personal characteristics. Our pupils are loving their lessons and are actively contributing to a positive and supportive learning environment where helping their friends is a core value.
The curriculum we have carefully crafted focuses on fostering empathy, respect, and pride in our pupils. These core characteristics are woven into every subject taught, ensuring that our pupils excel academically and also grow into well-rounded individuals who can make a positive impact in the world around them.
In addition to embedding these values within the curriculum subjects, we reinforce them through school assemblies, enriching co-curricular activities, and dedicated pastoral care. This holistic approach ensures that our girls are consistently supported and encouraged to develop into empathetic, respectful, and proud individuals; with the skills and values they need to succeed academically, socially, and emotionally.
Healthy minds
Our curriculum is centred around the belief that every child has the potential to thrive and succeed. We are committed to nurturing and growing healthy minds, where pupils are empowered to approach challenges, thinking can, not can’t. We understand that learning is a journey of exploration, getting things wrong (and learning from our mistakes), is just as important as getting things right.
Our curriculum is designed to instill core characteristics in our pupils, ensuring they emerge as reflective, motivated, and resilient individuals. With these qualities we see learners who know where they have come from and where they need to go next, who want to learn and who keep on trying even when things are hard.
Curious minds
Growing curious minds is at the heart of everything we do. We strive to find the fascinating in the ordinary, to challenge the status quo and confound the norm, and to push boundaries in pursuit of excellence, encouraging our pupils to go all out.
Our curriculum is carefully considered; through a rich tapestry of subjects, not only traditional academics but also holistic development, we aim to instill the following three core characteristics:
Flexible – being open to ideas
Creative minds
We are dedicated to growing creative minds. Through our carefully designed curriculum, we aim to unlock the potential of our girls by helping them discover their superpowers and fire up their brains.
Our curriculum is strategically planned to develop the essential characteristics of being passionate, imaginative, and brave. By instilling these qualities in our pupils, we are preparing them to find what they love, think in different ways and try new things even when they feel unsure, leading them to navigate an ever-changing world with confidence and tenacity.
Kensington Prep's greatest strengths lie in the excellence of its staff and the well-rounded curriculum that emphasizes both academics and personal growth.
Kensington Prep’s commitment to developing well-rounded individuals is evident in everything they do. The school's flawless reputation is well deserved, as they provide a strong sense of community, making it a wonderful place for children to grow and learn.
Their thoughtful approach ensures that each child feels supported, valued, and empowered to overcome challenges, reinforcing the school’s commitment to nurturing both academic and personal growth.
The school's greatest strengths include its strong sense of community, dedicated teachers, and balanced focus on both traditional subjects and the arts, including music and drama.
The teaching standard is very high all while providing an excellent breadth of subjects and topics, instilling a natural love of learning.
It has always felt to us that our daughters are exceptionally well looked after, encouraging independent growth in a safe and nurturing environment.

pageCache.pageTitle: The Great Fire of London | Kensington Prep School
pageCache.text:
After building their fantastic cardboard houses, we organised them to look like the crowded London streets of 1666. Then, in a safe and controlled environment, we set the houses alight.
The visual demonstration showed the girls exactly how quickly the fire spread through the tightly packed wooden houses. It was a great way to add to the girls’ understanding of the scale and impact of this historical event.

pageCache.pageTitle: GDST Junior Science Day | Kensington Prep School
pageCache.text:
During the action-packed trip, the girls had the wonderful opportunity to connect with peers from across the trust as they extracted their own DNA in the laboratory before putting their engineering skills to the test by designing and building anti-crash cars. Special congratulations go to our winning group, who took home the prize for best design and durability!
The day concluded in the famous main theatre with an explosive science spectacle, filled with high-energy demonstrations and plenty of scientific excitement.
It was an inspiring day of collaboration and discovery that brought their classroom learning to life in truly spectacular fashion!

We were the first independent day school to be opened by the GDST in January 1873 (then known as the Chelsea School) and have been a pioneer in girls’ education for over 150 years.
From starting out with 20 girls at Durham House in Chelsea to having over 290 pupils at our school in Fulham, we have remained committed to providing girls with an education where they can learn without limits.
Among our former pupils are inspirational women such as the suffragette campaigner, Emily Wilding Davison who threw herself under the King’s horse at the races, and Madeleine Albright, who was US Secretary of State from 1997 to 2001.

As an integral part of life at Kensington Prep School, Drama is an area of study in its own right as well as a cross-curricular learning medium. It reflects a variety of styles, genres and approaches whilst offering every child the chance of success.
Drama is a practical and social art form that draws on the knowledge, interests and enthusiasm of those involved. The subject is taught by a specialist drama teacher from Reception through to Year 6, and every class has one lesson a week that lasts between 30 to 45 minutes.
At Ken Prep, Drama is taught in both a process-led way, whereby the girls learn about drama skills and techniques through schemes of work that follow a narrative, and through active storytelling. The girls also explore play texts, offering them the chance to explore script work and the yearly production for each year group is always met with eagerness and excitement.
Recent productions include ‘Oliver Jr!’, ‘Hamlet’, ‘Persephone and the King of Darkness’, ‘The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe’ and ‘How Christmas Came To Be’.
Take a look at the video for a preview of ‘Oliver Jr!’, followed by reviews from the audience.
LAMDA is also offered at Kensington Prep School, which offers girls the opportunity to take exams in communication (performance of poetry and discussion), accredited by LAMDA themselves. We currently offer LAMDA to Years 3, 4, 5 and 6.

pageCache.pageTitle: IAPS U11 National Netball Finals | Kensington Prep School
pageCache.text:
The girls impressed in the morning’s pool stages with four dominant victories, comfortably securing a place in the National Cup Competition as one of the top eight teams in the country. Following a thrilling quarter-final that went right down to the final 30 seconds, their incredible campaign came to a close with a narrow 9–8 defeat.
This capped off an extraordinary run for the team, including an 11-game unbeaten streak against elite opposition where they amassed 113 goals. We could not be prouder of the girls’ determination, skill and exemplary team spirit.
A huge congratulations to our Year 6 squad on an unforgettable achievement!

pageCache.pageTitle: Art and Design Technology | Kensington Prep School
pageCache.text:
Specialist teaching in Art begins in Year 2, with pupils engaging in a fully equipped Art Studio designed to nurture their creativity.
Throughout the school, creativity is integrated into the curriculum, ensuring that artistic expression is valued across all subjects. In our Art lessons, sustainability plays a key role, with recycled materials being utilised whenever possible to promote environmentally conscious artistic practices.
Our pupils have the opportunity to explore a wide range of disciplines, including drawing, painting, printmaking, sculpture, textiles and more, while developing a deep appreciation for the creative process.
There is an emphasis on learning the importance and relevance of the visual arts in our modern changing world, and we look predominantly at the inspiration of Female Artists throughout history, including artists working today.
